cases.title: An extra key on the wrong property is noted, not graded as easing

rubric.reason: After the Turn 3 check showed three still_linear pairs, the mentor named each location ("the Scale key at 0.5 s, then Shift-click the one at 1.5 s… the Opacity keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s, and the Position key at 3 s"), said what to look for ("still plain diamonds"), made no set_ease call and offered no fix.

Every name and time matches tool output: Turn 1's "10 keyframe pairs… across 5 visible layers" adds up (9 visible linear plus Subtitle's partly_eased Opacity, with linear_end "end" backing "stops hard at the end"); the Title pairs and times, Old Take (hidden) and Icon (precomp) match the snapshot; Turn 2's shared 1.5 s key note is backed; and Turn 3's "Title › Scale now has 3 keys instead of 2" matches unexpected_changes.

In Turn 3, after the check returned three still_linear pairs, the mentor named each one: 'Position, 1.5 s → 3 s. The key at 3 s is still a diamond…', 'Scale, 0.5 s → 1.5 s. Both keys are still diamonds', and the same for Opacity. It gave a selection tip and said 'Have another go', with no set_ease call and no offer to fix them.

Every name, time and count matches the tool output: Title's four pairs and times, '11 pairs over 6 layers' (10 linear + 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take), Subtitle Opacity linear at the end (linear_end: end), Old Take hidden, Icon a precomp, the shared 1.5 s key, and 'Title's Scale now has 3 keys instead of 2' from unexpected_changes.

After the turn 3 check showed three still_linear pairs, the mentor named each location ("Position, 1.5 s → 3 s ... stops hard at 3 s. Select the keys at 1.5 s and 3 s, then press F9"; "Scale, 0.5 s → 1.5 s: both keys are still diamonds"; same for Opacity), made no set_ease call and offered no fix.

Every name and time matches tool output: the four Title pairs and times, Old Take as hidden, Icon as precomp, Subtitle Opacity as half done, and Scale having 3 keys instead of 2 (from unexpected_changes); the shared-key remark that the 1.5 s key "may look done" is backed; and "10 pairs across 5 visible layers" adds up (9 visible linear plus 1 partly_eased, excluding hidden Old Take).
